results.title: Champions of Change: Heart of a Saint
results.original_title: Champions of Change: Heart of a Saint
results.overview: In New Orleans, three men shaped by growing up without fathers - including NFL champion Tyrann Mathieu, famously known as the “Honey Badger” - return to their communities to become the mentors they once needed. Their mission is to inspire, uplift, and help build a stronger future for the city that raised them. The documentary beautifully intertwines Mathieu's story with those of local mentees and mentors, exploring the shared experiences of growing up without a father, overcoming adversity, and finding strength through mentorship, resilience, and community. These are stories of loss, but more importantly, stories of hope.
